my words being written on tablets

First he prefaces his invocation of Athena (287 ff.) with the statement that, as one already purified, he has the right to do so. He has already said something similar at 237 ff., when he sat down at the image, and when Athena questions him, he repeats it for the third time at 448 ff. At our passage it is directed against 258 ff., where the Erinyes denied him any legal decision and responsibility.
